import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SmallCNN(nn.Module):

  def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
    super(SmallCNN, self).__init__()
    # Input: 3 channels (RGB), 32x32 image size
    self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=16, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
    self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
    self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=16, out_channels=32, kernel_size=3, padding=1)

    # Fully connected layers (32x8x8 after two 2x2 max-pooling layers from 32x32)
    self.fc1 = nn.Linear(32 * 8 * 8, 128)
    self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, num_classes)

  def forward(self, x):
    x = self.pool(F.relu(self.conv1(x)))  # -> (16, 16, 16)
    x = self.pool(F.relu(self.conv2(x)))  # -> (32, 8, 8)
    x = torch.flatten(x, 1)  # Flatten all dimensions except batch
    x = F.relu(self.fc1(x))
    x = self.fc2(x)
    return x


# Quick test with a dummy batch of 4 RGB images (3 x 32 x 32)
model = SmallCNN(num_classes=10)
dummy_input = torch.randn(4, 3, 32, 32)
output = model(dummy_input)
print(output.shape)  # Output: torch.Size([4, 10])
